verdict.rationale: Docs mention MCP only as a general protocol concept ('MCP is an open standard protocol for seamless AI model integration with data sources and tools') but there is no evidence of Mistral publishing or hosting an official MCP server that agents can connect to; the closest material describes Mistral's own agents calling out to tools/functions, not serving as an MCP endpoint. As a platform (not itself an agent), this axis applies, but no first-party or independent evidence shows a shipped MCP server.
